NOTE
**Still not ready: no linked issue, so it's unclear this work was approved**

New: The author pushed 3 times, CI now passes, and they filled in the checklist and testing notes, which answers the CI feedback. Missing: the description has no "Fixes: #N" and no issue is linked, so there's no sign the change was requested or labeled "help wanted". The description also mentions only one of the two new fixtures.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to link a "help wanted" issue. If none exists, a maintainer (laurynmm gave the earlier feedback) should decide whether the PR can continue.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for fixing the CI issues! Please add a "Fixes: #N" line to the description pointing to a "help wanted" issue for this change (see our [contributing guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html)), and mention both fixture files in the testing notes.
```
